algorithm: {The algorithm uses a combination of Random Search (RS) and Cyclic Coordinate Descent (CCD) to efficiently explore the search space and converge towards the global minimum.}
{The algorithm implemented is a simple variant of the Random Search method with early stopping when the minimum value found by the search does not change after a certain number of iterations}

{The proposed algorithm uses a combination of random search and local refinement to efficiently minimize complex functions with multiple variables, iteratively sampling candidates within the given bounds and refining them using gradient-free optimization techniques until the budget is depleted.}
